en: Black‑and‑white street scene of a small Nordic village with wooden houses, a dirt/gravel road, a 1930s–40s style car, and a bicycle. Low rocky hills rise in the background. The nearest building on the right appears to be a small shop with large display windows. In the lower left the word "RIXÖ" is printed, and in the lower right a triangular photographer/printer logo with the number 2557 is visible.
